liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Highlights include ornate Scarlet Begonias and an exquisite Peggy-O with strong vocal licks [16]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer finds the transition to Fire On The Mountain unusually weird and stellar [20]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes Of The World is played uptempo and is considered fantastic [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-04-03.142815.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1982-04-03.sbd.miller.96069.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 3.5/5 by 16 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording is imperfect, but the transition into Fire On The Mountain is powerful; Reviewer criticizes the file as mostly audience recording, not a true soundboard; Sound is described as sloppy yet possessing a strange psychedelic undertone throughout [13][17][18][21]
- **gd1982-04-03.170734.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 188 min [5]
- **gd1982-04-03.nak700.wagner.82757.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes a strange psychedelic undertone despite some sloppy and lazy moments [19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the show at age sixteen, marking their first Grateful Dead concert [15]
- Believed to be the only Grateful Dead performance at The Scope venue [23]
- New transfer sounds superior to the reviewer's old second set cassette [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-04-03.142815.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-C90) [1]. Also: Bob Wagner provided the patch source for the soundboard recording [1]
- **gd1982-04-03.sbd.miller.96069.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> ? -> Cassette -> CD [3]. Also: Nakamichi 700 cassette master transferred to DAT and CD by Matt Smith [3]
- **gd1982-04-03.170734.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 (w/ Bass EQ) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B) [5]. Also: Craig L. supplied Nakamichi 304 source for patches in CC Rider and Drums [5]
- **gd1982-04-03.nak700.wagner.82757.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: A:C:D:CD Nak 700s>Sony TC-D5M [8]
